segments.name: Terminalling and Storage
segments.description: Owns and operates marine, specialty and underground terminals plus a naphthenic refinery, providing storage, refining and handling services for producers and suppliers of petroleum products.
segments.evidence: The Terminalling and Storage segment generates revenue by providing terminalling, processing, and storage services for petroleum products and by-products.

segments.name: Transportation
segments.description: Runs land truck and tank trailer fleets and inland marine barges and push boats hauling petroleum products, petrochemicals and chemicals for refinery and chemical customers.
segments.evidence: The Transportation segment earns revenue by offering land and marine transportation services for petroleum products, by-products, chemicals, and specialty products.

segments.name: Sulfur Services
segments.description: Processes, manufactures, markets and distributes sulfur and sulfur-based fertilizer products for wholesale distributors and industrial users from Gulf Coast, Texas and Illinois plants.
segments.evidence: The Sulfur Services segment generates revenue by providing processing, manufacturing, marketing, and distribution services for sulfur and sulfur-based products.

segments.name: Specialty Products
products: private label agricultural, automotive, and industrial lubricants
segments.description: Blends and packages private label lubricants and greases and markets, distributes and transports NGLs to industrial users and propane retailers.
segments.evidence: The Specialty Products segment earns revenue by providing marketing, distribution, and transportation services for NGLs as well as blending and packaging services for specialty lubricants and greases.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay fixed tank fees, throughput and tolling fees, mileage and trip rates, and product prices for sulfur, NGLs, lubricants and greases.
revenueModel.evidence: Storage revenue is earned through contracted monthly tank fixed fees, while throughput revenue is based on the volume moved through the Partnership's terminals at contracted rates.
